candy_land.png:
What design/concept/candy_land.png shows:
This image is a flat, minimalist vector illustration. A light blue sky (#B0E0F0) holds three white oval clouds (#FFFFFF). Below, a curved pink ground (#FFC0CB) sits atop a light green base (#B0E0E6). Seven lollipop-like objects with white sticks are evenly spaced: left to right, purple (#9B59B6), pink (#FF6B6B), pink, yellow (#FFD166), pink, purple, pink. Each has a white curved "smile" on top.  

Art style: Clean, flat design with solid colors and no gradients/shadows. Mood: Playful, cheerful. Shapes: Circles (lollipops), ovals (clouds), curves (ground). Proportions: Lollipops are uniform in stick length and circular head size.  

No explicit gameplay cues, but the lollipops suggest collectible items or obstacles in a whimsical, candy-themed setting.

desert_ruins.png:
What design/concept/desert_ruins.png shows:
This image depicts a minimalist desert sunset scene. A large, solid yellow sun (#FFC107) sits low on the horizon, partially obscured by curved brown hills (#A66A3D). The sky transitions from deep purple (#6A3B7D) at the top to warm orange (#E69C5B) near the horizon. Two stylized structures flank the sun: left has two tall brown rectangles (#5D4037) with a shorter horizontal bar on top; right has three vertical brown bars of varying heights. All elements use flat, geometric shapes with no gradients or textures. The art style is clean vector illustration, emphasizing simplicity and bold color blocking. Mood is calm and serene, evoking a tranquil dusk. Shapes are basic (circles, rectangles, curves), with proportions favoring the sun’s dominance and structured symmetry of the landmarks. No explicit gameplay cues, but the structures suggest potential environmental markers or obstacles in a desert-themed game.
foggy_forest.png:
What design/concept/foggy_forest.png shows:
Minimalist 2D scene: a small black silhouette (player character) holds an orange circle (#FF9900) amid tall, pointed conical trees. Trees use dark gray (#333333), medium gray (#666666), and light gray (#CCCCCC) for layered depth. Background: muted gray sky (#AAAAAA) and light gray ground (#CCCCCC). Art style: flat, geometric vector with solid shapes (no gradients/textures). Mood: serene yet mysterious, emphasized by monochrome palette and lone figure. Shapes: sharp triangular cones (trees), vertical silhouette (character), circular element (orange). Proportions: Trees dominate vertically (tall, narrow), character small (1:10 scale vs. trees). Gameplay hints: Character likely player; orange circle suggests collectible/tool. Forest layout implies navigation/puzzle mechanics. (198 words)
gothic_castle.png:
What design/concept/gothic_castle.png shows:
This image shows a minimalist, flat-style castle silhouette against a gradient night sky. The castle has multiple pointed spires (towers) of varying heights, with small red rectangular windows (some lit). A large full moon sits in the upper right, and three black bird silhouettes (resembling bats) fly leftward.  

Art style: Vector-based, solid-color flat design with no gradients on the castle.  
Colors: Sky gradient from #4A3A5A (top) to #6A5A7A (bottom); castle = #000000; moon = #F5F5F5; windows = #FF0000.  
Mood: Eerie, spooky (Halloween-inspired).  
Shapes: Geometric (sharp spires, circular moon, simple bird outlines). Proportions: Castle dominates center; moon is large relative to the structure.  
Gameplay hints: Castle likely a level/fortress; red windows suggest active areas or hazards; birds imply environmental threats.

At the peak, a bright orange (hex: #FF4500) rectangular crater emits thin, curved yellow-orange (hex: #FFA500) lines (suggesting smoke or lava). The background is a solid dark red-brown (hex: #8B0000).  

Art style: Geometric vector with solid colors, no gradients. Shapes are clean triangles, rectangles, and lines. Proportions: Volcano centered, lava flow vertical, crater small relative to the cone.  

Mood: Urgent, fiery. Colors contrast sharply (dark background vs. bright lava).  

Gameplay hints: Lava flow implies a hazard path; smoke lines suggest active eruption. Likely a platformer/puzzle where lava navigation is key.
